I did not find the colors to change.
dict.Cernelurile cu care se tipărește documen: The inks the document prints with: the 4 process inks and the spot colors (special inks, each on its own plate). A spot color can be sent to another ink's plate (alias), for example when the same Pantone is spelled two ways, or converted to process (a mix of Cyan, Magenta, Yellow and Black) when the print shop does not have that ink.
dict.Toate culorile spot se tipăresc ca amest: All spot colors print as a mix of Cyan, Magenta, Yellow and Black
dict.Alias-ul nu s-a putut face: culorile ale: The alias could not be made: the chosen colors would have ended up on the same plate in the same mix.
dict.Culorile spot alese nu apar în text sau: The chosen spot colors do not appear in text or drawings (only in pictures or gradients), so they were kept.
